* Foreign affairs minister of Finland, [[Erkki Tuomioja]], says that [[NATO]] could be a good option for the [[Scandinavia]]n country. Finland has been previously very conservative about military alliances and known for its neutrality. [https://web.archive.org/web/20060221025250/http://www.helsinginsanomat.fi/tuoreet/artikkeli/tulosta/1054730299020 (In Finnish)] A more balanced view is given in an interview in [http://www.helsinki-hs.net/news.asp?id=20030610IE6 Helsingin Sanomat's English edition of June 10].
* [[Empire Maker]] wins the [[Belmont Stakes]] horse race, stopping the bid of [[Funny Cide]] to win the [[Triple Crown of Thoroughbred Racing]].  Funny Cide is third, behind [[Ten Most Wanted (horse)]].
